name: rubry
description: Build your own multi-agent assistant on Cloudflare Workers and Mastra, and connect it to rubry.ai.

scripts.dev: npm run migrate:local -w middleware && cd middleware && wrangler dev -c wrangler.jsonc -c ../agents/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.check: npm run check -w agents && npm run check -w middleware
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy -w agents && npm run deploy -w middleware
